title: Composite delete: the compositeSections branch of the page body, its CSS, the dead overview hider and the showCompositeJump frontmatter go; the file becomes GameCultContent.tsx
first: Map: docs/masthead-campaign.md, section 'One column' (map revision 4), fact C5. Ruling: operator-chromeless-column ('nix the unused composite component'). Line numbers from 535d170; re-read by selector.

What is live: site/quartz/components/GameCultCompositeContent.tsx is the pageBody for ContentPage and FolderPage (site/quartz.config.ts 85-90). Its base path (resolveGameCultSourceFile, rebaseSharedSourceElement for contentSource pages, stripTopTagline, the Blog AutoIndexFolder, the folder fallback) renders every page and stays.

What is dead, prove each before cutting: (a) no file under GameCult/ sets compositeSections (rg -l compositeSections GameCult returns nothing), so getCompositeSections always returns [] and the sections.length > 0 branch (lines 228-266) never renders; (b) .gamecult-composite-* CSS (custom.scss 1744-1891 and the mobile block 2202-2223) styles only that branch, except .gamecult-composite-overview; (c) .gamecult-composite-overview > h2, > ul (1754-1757) hides nothing: tour.md carries the class (line 62) but its <h2>s sit inside .gamecult-vn-source-card divs and the file has no top-level ## heading or list, so in the built /tour HTML article.gamecult-composite-overview has zero direct h2 or ul children; (d) showCompositeJump is read only by the dead branch (index.md 5, Pitch.md 5, tour.md 5).

Rename: with the branch gone the file's name lies. git mv to GameCultContent.tsx, the component to GameCultContent, and the import in quartz.config.ts follows. The Options type (fallback: content | folder) stays.

Imports that become unused in the file and go with the branch: ComponentChildren stays (baseContent), normalizeHastElement and resolveGameCultReferenceSlug leave (used only by buildSectionContent/getCompositeSections). resolveGameCultReferenceSlug stays exported from gamecult.ts (resolveGameCultSourceFile uses it).

Not this cut: the AutoIndexFolder sidebarTagline/sidebarSummary options in the same file and anything sidebar; cut sidebars-gone takes them. .quartz-build/ is the ignored build staging; never edit it.

deletes.note: CompositeSection type (28-34), buildSectionContent (69-137), getCompositeSections (139-166), the sections/showCompositeJump reads (203-204) and the sections.length > 0 render (228-266); imports normalizeHastElement and resolveGameCultReferenceSlug. The sections.length === 0 guard collapses: the three fallback returns become the body.

1744-1891 whole: body[data-slug="tour"] .gamecult-composite-sections, .gamecult-composite-page, .gamecult-composite-overview (dead hider), -jump, -sections, -section, -divider, -shell, -shell.has-media, -media (4 rules), -copy, -header, -header h2, the min-width trio, -body rules, and the @container block.
2202-2223 inside @media ($mobile): the five .gamecult-composite-* rules deleted; .gamecult-feature-grid and the rules after it stay.
cssclasses: - gamecult-composite-overview (61-62) deleted whole (the class has no other value).

keeps_moves: git mv site/quartz/components/GameCultCompositeContent.tsx site/quartz/components/GameCultContent.tsx; the default export's inner component is GameCultContent; quartz.config.ts line 4 imports GameCultContent and lines 85-90 call it.
rebaseSharedSourceElement, resolveGameCultSourceFile, stripTopTagline, the Blog AutoIndexFolder instance, the folder fallback and the article class list: unchanged.
docs/gamecult-quartz-extraction-plan.md mentions the composite page as history; untouched.

authority_map.owner: GameCultContent.tsx owns the article body of every content and folder page; it has one shape, article.popover-hint around the page's own tree (or the Blog index, or the folder listing).
inputs: the page's htmlAst, or its contentSource file's
outputs: one article per page; no composite wrapper, jump nav, section shell or divider exists in any built page
derived_state: compositeSections and showCompositeJump are read by nothing and are deleted from content, not left inert
the class gamecult-composite-overview is emitted by nothing and styled by nothing
forbidden_writers: no composite string in site/ or GameCult/ after the cut (the extraction-plan doc under docs/ is history and exempt)
no change to the base render path, the Blog AutoIndexFolder options, the sidebar code, the masthead or the engine
shared_paths: ContentPage and FolderPage emitters share the one component; the same Deploy Quartz workflow
authority_map.deletion_line: The branch and its CSS are deleted in the first commit; the rename is the second; nothing is added.
